welcome.name: Yeison Andrés
welcome.intro: Full Stack Developer with a focus on Backend and databases, specialized in Node.js, TypeScript, Express.js, and SQL to build applications and APIs focused on real-world needs.

about_me_text1: As a Full Stack Developer, I have experience building web applications, REST APIs, database integrations, and external services. My main professional interest is Backend development and data management.
about_me_text1.1: I am a Software Analysis and Development Technologist from SENA, with training in Full Stack development. I mainly work with Node.js, TypeScript, Express.js, SQL, and Docker, while maintaining complementary knowledge in frontend development, Python, Java, and automation.
about_me_text2: My profile combines Full Stack development with a growing focus on Backend, databases, software architecture, and service integration.
about_me_text2.1: I am currently strengthening my Backend knowledge and progressively building my profile toward Cloud, infrastructure, and distributed systems, while continuing to develop applications.
